changes in mindfulness facets were associated with PTSD treatment outcome and that the facets of mindfulness associated with PTSD outcome were not necessarily the same as those associated with depression.
pre- to posttreatment changes in facets mindfulness are significantly associated with PTSD and depression severity in a residential PTSD treatment sample.
changes in acting with awareness and nonjudgmental awareness are uniquely associated with changes in PTSD and depression severity, respectively.

the potential role of mindfulness in PTSD treatment.
the impact of changes of mindfulness on treatment outcomes.
the role of mindfulness facets in predicting treatment outcomes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
changes in acting with awareness and nonjudgmental awareness are important in PTSD treatment outcomes.

the current study provides evidence for the prospective association between changes in facets of nonjudgmental and acting with awareness with posttraumatic stress and depression severity at the end of residential treatment.

, in a sample of 48 military Veterans receiving cognitive-behaviorally oriented residential PTSD treatment, changes in facets mindfulness explained a significant portion of post-treatment PTSD symptom severity, and that changes in acting with awareness were uniquely associated with PTSD severity and changes with nonjudgmental awareness were uniquely associated to depression severity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
changes in facets of nonjudgmental awareness and acceptance of the present moment are associated with better outcomes for PTSD and depressive symptoms.

the more a Veteran was able to act with awareness of his or her experiences, and accept his or her experiences non-judgmentally, the less severe his or her PTSD and depressive symptoms were at treatment discharge.
the present findings suggest that mindfulness-based treatments may be most beneficial for those who show the greatest improvements in facets of mindfulness.
The main takeaway from our work is that
changes in facets of nonjudgmental awareness and acting with awareness are associated with PTSD and depression symptom improvement, respectively.
changes in facets of mindful awareness are associated with changes in PTSD and depression severity.
the facets of mindfulness are important targets for change in PTSD treatment.
